# k0rdent_webhook_subscriptions (Data Source)

Every webhook subscription the credential's organization has, with each endpoint's delivery health.

Set `url` to find the subscriptions to one endpoint. That's the way back from a create whose answer was lost: the platform picks a subscription's id, so the list is the only place to find it, and an import adopts it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every subscription to one endpoint. Use it to find an id to import.

data "k0rdent_webhook_subscriptions" "hooks" {
  url = "https://hooks.example.com/k0rdent"
}

output "subscription_ids" {
  # [*] takes `id` from every subscription.
  value = data.k0rdent_webhook_subscriptions.hooks.subscriptions[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Only the subscriptions whose `is_active` is this value: `false` finds the endpoints the platform has stopped delivering to. Filtered in the provider, after the whole list is read: the list operation takes no such filter.
- `url` (String) Only the subscriptions to this endpoint, compared exactly as the platform reports it.

### Read-Only

- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) The subscriptions, in id order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `consecutive_failures` (Number) Deliveries dead-lettered since `last_success_at`, not counting one still being retried. Zero for a healthy endpoint.
- `created_at` (String) When the subscription was created, as RFC 3339.
- `event_types` (Set of String) The event types delivered. Null means every event.
- `failing_since` (String) When the current run of failures began. Null when `consecutive_failures` is 0. Read the two together to tell a blip from an endpoint that's been down for days.
- `id` (String) The subscription's id, a UUID.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the platform delivers events to the subscription's `url`. It reads `false` once the platform has turned the subscription off because deliveries there kept failing, which can't be undone: only deleting it and creating it again gets deliveries going.
- `last_success_at` (String) When the endpoint last accepted a delivery with a 2xx. Null if it never has.
- `previous_secret_expires_at` (String) When the previous secret stops being accepted. Only set while a rotation's overlap is open.
- `rotated_at` (String) When the secret was last rotated. Null if it never has been.
- `secret_version` (Number) The platform's count of signing secrets, which every delivery carries as `X-K0r-Signature-Version`.
- `url` (String) The endpoint the platform POSTs events to.
